roadmap.title: Arrival and survival milestones
roadmap.description: Survive the first fifty days on Site 2 while you craft the basic weapons, place your first logs, eat fish and pick up the cheap early unlocks.

roadmap.title: Caves, tools and dig sites
roadmap.description: Recover the Rebreather, Rope Gun and Shovel, dig out the dig sites and graves, and clear the Sluggies blocking the cave routes.

roadmap.title: Bunkers, keycards and collections
roadmap.description: Work through the bunkers and caves for keycards and printer resin, then finish the watch, money, print, camera, note and blueprint checklists.

roadmap.title: Companions and multiplayer
roadmap.description: Earn Virginia's trust, hand her a GPS locator, and get admin rights in a multiplayer session hosted by someone else.

roadmap.title: Late-game crafting and long grinds
roadmap.description: Build out the big log counts, craft the full Tech Armor set, plate every compatible weapon with Solafite, and eat every edible type.

roadmap.title: Story finale and endings
roadmap.description: Reach the magma chamber with Kelvin and Virginia alive, then save before the final choice and play out both endings.

achievements.summary: Drink 50 cans of Fi-Z energy drink.

guide.context: Fi-Z cans are common in crates and at abandoned camps, and the keycard-locked section of the printer cave holds a large supply that refills after a save and reload.

steps.text: Loot @item{Fi-Z} cans from crates, abandoned camps and bunkers.
Drink 50 cans.
steps.note: Save and reload at the printer cave to make its Fi-Z supply respawn.

achievements.description: Craft and wear a full set of Tech Armor.
achievements.summary: Craft and equip a full set of Tech Armor.

guide.context: A full set is 10 pieces, and each piece needs one Tech Mesh plus four other components.

steps.text: Print @item{Tech Mesh} at a 3D printer for 250 mL of resin each.
Craft one @item{Tech Armor} piece from 1 circuit board, 1 battery, 1 wire, 1 tape and 1 Tech Mesh.
Repeat until you have 10 pieces, then equip the whole set.
steps.note: Save and reload to make the printer's resin respawn if you run short.

achievements.summary: Pick up 50 Drogue watches.

guide.context: Watches stack to 10, so store or spend them to keep room for more.

steps.text: Loot @item{Drogue watches} from grey crates, facilities and skin pouches.
Save and reload at the golf course plane crash site, where suitcases often hold watches, until you have picked up 50.

achievements.summary: Collect a total of $1000.

guide.context: Money spawns as coin piles and dollar bills, and many of these piles reappear when you revisit a site.

steps.text: Loot coins and dollar bills from abandoned camps, bodies on spikes and bunkers.
Empty the guest keycard bunker, where a briefcase and loose cash hold around $200.
Unlock the printer cave's keycard door to reach the club behind it, then save and reload there to farm cash until the running total reaches $1000.

achievements.description: Eat one of every edible type.
achievements.summary: Eat one of every edible food type in the game.

guide.context: Progress needs all 37 edible types on one save. If the achievement does not pop, eat @item{Aloe Vera} a second time.

steps.text: Eat every berry: @item{Blueberry}, @item{Blackberry}, @item{Salmonberry}, @item{Guarana Berry}, @item{Twinberry} and @item{Snowberry}.
Eat every herb: @item{Yarrow}, @item{Horsetail}, @item{Fireweed}, @item{Devil's Club}, @item{Chicory}, @item{Arrowleaf} and @item{Aloe Vera}.
Eat every mushroom: @item{Shiitake}, @item{Fly Amanita}, @item{Hydnum Repandum} and @item{King Oyster}.
Craft and eat the four herbal mixes: @item{Energy Mix}, @item{Energy Mix+}, @item{Health Mix} and @item{Health Mix+}.
steps.note: Health Mix is aloe vera plus yarrow; Health Mix+ adds horsetail and fireweed; Energy Mix is arrowleaf plus chicory; Energy Mix+ is chicory, devil's club and fireweed.

steps.text: Eat the animal foods: @item{Fish}, @item{Meat}, @item{Oyster}, @item{Turtle Egg}, @item{Human Arm} and @item{Human Leg}.
steps.note: Human arms and legs come from dismembering cannibals with a sharp weapon. Turtle eggs only appear in summer: stand near a sea turtle on a sandy beach and wait for it to lay, then pick the eggs up.

steps.text: Eat the packaged foods: @item{Bacon Bite}, @item{Brain Bite}, @item{Canned Food}, @item{Crunchie Wunchies}, @item{Energy Bar}, @item{Energy Drink}, @item{Meds}, @item{MRE Pack}, @item{Ramen Noodles} and @item{Steak Bite}.
steps.note: Canned food needs the @item{Can Opener} first, and the Food and Dining Bunker dining room holds bacon, brain and steak bites.

achievements.summary: Survive one full in-game day on the island.

steps.text: Stay alive until the second in-game day begins.
steps.note: It unlocks as the night of day 1 ends.

achievements.description: Survive ten days on the island.
achievements.summary: Survive 10 full in-game days on the island.

steps.text: Stay alive until day 11 begins.
steps.note: Sleeping through each night is the quickest way to pass the time.

achievements.summary: Survive 25 full in-game days on the island.

steps.text: Stay alive until day 26 begins.

achievements.summary: Survive 50 full in-game days on the island.

guide.context: The counter only advances while you play, so the day achievements arrive on their own during a long run.

steps.text: Stay alive until day 51 begins.
steps.note: Sleep through every night to move the counter faster.

achievements.description: Become an admin in a multiplayer game.
achievements.summary: Be made an admin in a multiplayer game hosted by another player.

guide.context: Only the host can grant the rank, and the older trusted rank no longer unlocks the achievement.

steps.text: Join a multiplayer session hosted by another player.
Have the host open the pause menu, go to @mechanic{Players} and switch your rank from Guest to Admin.

achievements.summary: Own every collectible outfit in the game.

guide.context: Clothing lies in bunkers, caves, camps and vehicles across the island; the swim suit is Virginia's starting outfit and the tactical jacket is your own. The 3D-printed Red Mask and the Gold Mask from the second-to-last bunker are wearable too, so collect them as well if the achievement stays locked.

collectibles.name: Tactical Jacket
collectibles.method: You and Kelvin begin the game already wearing it.

collectibles.name: Blazer
collectibles.location: In a boat on the island's southern coast.
collectibles.method: Board the boat and pick up the blazer.

collectibles.name: Hoodie
collectibles.location: In a tent at an abandoned camp.
collectibles.method: Search the camp tents and pick up the hoodie.

collectibles.name: Leather Jacket
collectibles.method: Search the wreck for the leather jacket.

collectibles.name: Pajamas
collectibles.location: In the printer bunker's spa area; also found on the Good Times yacht and in the final bunker.
collectibles.method: Search the wardrobe or cabin and pick up the pajamas.

collectibles.name: Space Suit
collectibles.location: Residential Bunker level 2, in the room just before the Luxury Bunker.

collectibles.name: Tuxedo
collectibles.location: Buried Maintenance A bunker, in the bathroom.
collectibles.method: Dig down to the hatch, follow the corridor to the bathroom and pick up the tuxedo.

collectibles.name: Camouflage Suit
collectibles.location: On the seat of the abandoned helicopter outside the Residential Bunker.

collectibles.name: Leather Suit
collectibles.location: Residential Bunker level 2, in a wardrobe.
collectibles.method: Search the wardrobe and pick up the leather suit.

collectibles.name: Swim Suit
collectibles.method: Virginia wears it from the start, so no pickup is needed.

collectibles.name: Track Suit
collectibles.method: Reach the pool with the maintenance keycard and pick up the tracksuit.

collectibles.name: Priest Outfit
collectibles.location: Old cabin by the frozen lake on the north mountain.
collectibles.method: Pick up the priest outfit from the cabin.

collectibles.name: Winter Jacket
collectibles.location: In a large tent at an abandoned camp on the north-east side of the island.
collectibles.method: Search the tent and pick up the winter jacket.

collectibles.name: Wetsuit
collectibles.location: Shovel cave, past the flooded section.
collectibles.method: Swim through the flooded tunnel with the rebreather and pick up the wetsuit.

achievements.summary: Place 50 logs.

guide.context: Logs placed by hand on the ground count, and the running total is reported to carry across your saves.

steps.text: Chop a tree with an @item{axe} and collect the logs it drops.
Place 50 logs on the ground by hand.

achievements.summary: Place 100 logs.

guide.context: Logs placed by hand on the ground count, and the running total is reported to carry across your saves.

steps.text: Fill up on @item{logs} by chopping trees with an axe.
Place 100 logs on the ground by hand.
To speed the count up, place two logs, pick them back up with @mechanic{C} and place them again.

achievements.summary: Place 500 logs.

guide.context: Logs placed by hand on the ground count, and the running total is reported to carry across your saves.

steps.text: Stock up on @item{logs} by chopping trees with an axe.
Place two logs, pick them back up with @mechanic{C} and place them again, repeating until 500 logs have been placed.

achievements.summary: Place 1000 logs.

guide.context: Logs placed by hand count even if you pick the same logs up again, and the total is reported to carry across your saves.

steps.text: Keep yourself supplied with @item{logs} from chopped trees.
Place two logs on the ground, pick them back up with @mechanic{C} and place them again, repeating until the count reaches 1000.
steps.note: If the count appears stuck, keep placing newly chopped logs and it will catch up.

achievements.summary: Destroy a Sluggy with an explosive.

guide.context: Sluggies are masses of flesh and limbs that seal cave passages, and time bombs usually lie next to them.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Sluggy} in the Shovel Cave or Rope Gun Cave; one blocks the cave beside the forest helicopter with two time bombs nearby.
Throw a time bomb or grenade at it and stay clear of the blast.
steps.note: A grenade is more reliable than the time bombs for clearing a Sluggy.

achievements.description: Survive five kicks from a heavy cannibal.
achievements.summary: Take five kicks from a heavy cannibal.

guide.context: Heavy cannibals are the large club-wielding ones that patrol camps and caves.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{heavy cannibal} and stop a short distance in front of it so it charges.
Walk towards it as it charges so it lands the kick instead of a club swing.
Take five kicks, healing between them if needed.

achievements.description: Give a GPS locator to Virginia.
achievements.summary: Give Virginia a GPS locator.

guide.context: She only accepts gifts once her sentiment is high enough that she approaches you.

steps.text: Pick up a @item{GPS Locator} from a purple map marker, or print a GPS locator case for 50 mL of resin and craft it with 1 wire, 1 battery and 1 circuit board.
Spend time with @npc{Virginia} until she walks up to you and accepts gifts.
Offer her the GPS locator from your inventory.

achievements.summary: Craft every weapon and tool that can be made in the crafting menu.

guide.context: Weapon attachments do not count. The utility knife used to make the Crafted Spear is returned, not consumed.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Torch} from 1 stick and 1 cloth.
Craft a @item{Crafted Bow} from 2 sticks, 1 tape and 1 rope.
Craft a @item{Crafted Club} from 1 skull, 1 rope and 1 stick.
Craft a @item{Crafted Spear} from 2 sticks, 1 tape and 1 utility knife.
Craft a @item{Repair Tool} from 1 stick, 1 rock and 1 rope.
Craft a @item{Molotov} from 1 vodka bottle and 1 cloth.
steps.note: Make both the Repair Tool and the Molotov so nothing is left out.

achievements.summary: Eat 20 raw fish.

guide.context: The fish must be swallowed raw, so do not cook them first.

steps.text: Spear @item{fish} in shallow ponds and streams, or order @npc{Kelvin} to catch fish for you.
Eat 20 raw fish from your inventory.

achievements.summary: Dig 100 holes with the shovel.

guide.context: Dig spots show on the GPS as a dot inside a ring, and every successful shovel stroke counts as one hole.

steps.text: Recover the @item{Rebreather} and the @item{Rope Gun} from their caves.
Use them to reach the @item{Shovel} in the cave on the west side of the island near the mountain.
Dig 100 holes at GPS dig sites, gravestones or open ground.

achievements.summary: Dig 1000 holes with the shovel.

guide.context: The achievement counts shovel strokes, so 1000 holes is far less work than it sounds.

steps.text: Take the @item{Shovel} to any dig site, grave or patch of ground.
Dig along the edge of a hole or hatch so you never have to walk between spots.
Keep digging until 1000 strokes are counted.

achievements.summary: Be killed by a shark.

guide.context: At full health you drown before a shark can finish you, so weaken yourself before you swim out.

steps.text: Swim into deep water near the ocean @loc{life raft} and wait for a @enemy{shark} to attack.
steps.note: There is also a shark where the rebreather cave exits into the water.

achievements.description: Print one of every 3D printer item.
achievements.summary: Print one of every item a 3D printer can make.

guide.context: The printed GPS locator case does not count, and your character can only carry 1000 mL of printer resin at a time.

steps.text: Gather printer resin at the @loc{3D Printer} cave and other printer sites; the full list costs about 1700 mL.
Print @item{Arrows} (50 mL), @item{Grappling Hook} (100 mL), @item{Flask} (100 mL), @item{Red Mask} (150 mL), @item{Tech Mesh} (250 mL) and @item{Sled} (1000 mL).
steps.note: Printer resin respawns when you save and reload, so the printer cave can supply the whole list.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum sentiment with Virginia.

guide.context: Sentiment is a hidden value, and she flees if you crowd her or keep weapons drawn early on.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Virginia} with your weapons holstered and stay about 10 metres away until she stops fleeing.
Spend time near her, watch her dances from start to finish and give her each outfit you find.
Fight enemies close to her; this raises sentiment faster.
steps.note: Accept her beckons and gifts, and never hit her during fights.

achievements.description: Leave the island on the helicopter.
achievements.summary: Leave the island on the helicopter at the end of the story.

guide.context: The final choice sits at the end of the magma chamber, so save there to reload for the other ending.

steps.text: Follow the story to the @loc{magma chamber} and squeeze through the final crevice.
When the cutscene ends, board the @item{helicopter} with Eric and Timmy.

achievements.summary: Stay on the island when the story ends.

guide.context: This is the other half of the final choice, so a save in the magma chamber lets you see both endings.

steps.text: Follow the story to the @loc{magma chamber} and squeeze through the final crevice.
When the cutscene ends, turn around and pick up your pack instead of boarding the helicopter.

achievements.description: Complete the story with all friendly NPCs alive.
achievements.summary: Finish the story with Kelvin and Virginia both alive and on good terms.

guide.context: Virginia must be at maximum sentiment before the finale, and a companion who dies permanently locks this out for that save.

steps.text: Keep @npc{Kelvin} alive; revive him when enemies down him and do not leave him behind.
Raise @npc{Virginia} to maximum sentiment before you enter the finale.
Reach the cutscene where the group enters the cube with both companions still alive.

achievements.description: Plate all valid weapons with Solafite.
achievements.summary: Plate all 14 compatible weapons with Solafite.

guide.context: Each plating cycle consumes 6 Solafite, so all 14 weapons need 84 ore. An interrupted cycle returns the weapon unplated and wastes the ore. Plating the Ancient Armor is not needed here.

steps.text: Find the @item{Item Plating} blueprint in @loc{Cave F} and build a @item{Weapon Plater} from 11 sticks, 4 golf cart batteries, 7 stones, 3 wires and 3 turtle shells.
Mine @item{Solafite} with the @item{Pickaxe} from cave deposits and snowy mountain veins, or loot loose ore from the fishing huts along the shore.
Place 6 Solafite and one weapon in the plater, then survive the lightning and mutant waves until the cycle finishes.
steps.note: A cycle takes about two and a half minutes.

steps.text: Plate the melee weapons: @item{Crafted Club}, @item{Katana}, @item{Machete}, @item{Putter}, @item{Pickaxe}, @item{Firefighter Axe}, @item{Modern Axe}, @item{Tactical Axe}, @item{Guitar} and @item{Cross}.
Plate the firearms: @item{Pistol}, @item{Revolver}, @item{Shotgun} and @item{Rifle}.

achievements.summary: Find all 16 discoverable blueprints.

guide.context: Blueprints add build options to your survival notebook. If the achievement stays locked at 16/16, save and quit, verify the game files, relaunch and pick up a stick.

achievements.summary: Watch every found footage recording from the four action cameras.

achievements.summary: Collect all 50 note pages.

guide.context: Your survival notebook shows how many notes you have. If the achievement stays locked at 50/50, save and quit, verify the game files, relaunch and pick up a stick.
